description: Persistent plug-and-play MCP activity dashboard for the owner's exact Ditoo Plus; Runtime 002 adds telemetry-only live session observability. Runtime 003 re-binds the policy to the session-profile Host build. Runtime 004 re-binds the policy to the Host build with a separate streaming-profile ceiling. Runtime 006 adds physical-button pagination: the Ditoo's left/right arrows page through a wrap-around list (dashboard first), a short lever pull runs the current page's own action, input from the receive-only ButtonProbe (SMTC, mirror status) run as a child of the product. Runtime 007: Host re-bind only: the candidate Host sends every session's FIRST frame with the proven 10 ms packet spacing (first-frame IMAGE_RX_RECV_TIMEOUT: 5/19 streaming_ack_clock opens vs 0/199 activity opens, captures/OPENDITOO-STREAMING-FIRST-FRAME-TIMEOUT-ANALYSIS-2026-09-10.json); later frames keep the profile spacing. Build is path-independent (PathMap). Runtime 008 (HF-4): every page (dashboard with the UI-1 lightning pulse, three-reel slots) in ONE streaming_ack_clock Host session (PageCarousel); Left/Right change pixels only; InteractiveTransport pacing (50 ms client floor + 45 ms Host-anchored gap); Host-confirmed stock yield reclaims the same page; hidden-page collection on a joined worker. Accepted as OPENDITOO-INTERACTIVE-HF3-008 (11 cycles, 66/66 inputs, 0 faults). Runtime 009: exactly Runtime 008 plus owner-review fixes: the lightning glow draws only the icon's own pixels (no lone above-icon 'spark' after the hit), and a session's first ACK is always persisted to telemetry. Runtime 010 successor adds Pocket Moss as the third single-session page plus generic page-first modal Left/Right capture; all Moss art/animation sources and the Pixel Animation Lab compiler are hash-bound. Runtime 010 was subsequently cut over and is the live rollback baseline for Runtime 011. Runtime 011 is an art-readability-only successor: Moss v2 replaces the physically ambiguous v1 brown silhouette; transport and interaction semantics are unchanged. Runtime 012 is a polish-only successor: Moss v3 keeps the successful v2 identity while adding depth shading and richer authored Dance/Pet/Kisses choreography; product-control semantics remain unchanged.
